title: ComfyStudio: Timeline-Based AI Video Editor for ComfyUI
summary: An open-source non-linear video editor (NLE) built on top of ComfyUI. It integrates a traditional timeline with AI generation workflows, allowing for iterative video creation, shot planning, and multi-track editing.
research_notes: Features 'Hardware Tiers' for VRAM-aware generation and includes an integrated local LLM for prompt assistance and storyboard planning.

evolution.summary: Evolved from a private storyboard tool into a full-featured AI video workstation with multi-track support, keyframing, and 'Director Mode' for structured production. Recent updates added a Workflow Manager for automated node/model discovery and installation.
